description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity of an Android app, handling UI setup, navigation, fetching banner images, and populating various content rails with data from API endpoints.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity handles the main screen UI, including navigation bar, banner carousel, and various content rails; manages data fetching from APIs and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI elements, sets navigation callbacks, and triggers fetching banners and content rails.

methods.name: setupPosterRail
methods.description: Sets up a RecyclerView with a horizontal layout for content posters, attaching an adapter and item decoration.

methods.name: openContentInfo
methods.description: Opens a detailed content screen for a selected poster item with a fade transition.

methods.name: fetchAllRails
methods.description: Initiates fetching data for all content categories/rails.

methods.name: setActiveNavHome
methods.description: Highlights the 'Home' navigation item visibly active.

methods.name: setNavColors
methods.description: Updates visual styles of navigation bar items, emphasizing the active one with bold font.

methods.name: showLoading
methods.description: Shows or hides the banner loading indicator.

methods.name: showError
methods.description: Shows or hides the error container.

methods.name: setBanners
methods.description: Updates the banner adapter with a list of banner image URLs.

methods.name: parseBanners
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract banner image URLs.

methods.name: fetchBanners
methods.description: Performs API call to fetch banner images, handles success and error states.

methods.name: fetchRail
methods.description: Fetches content items for a specific content category, updating the adapter and visibility accordingly.

methods.name: attemptFetchRail
methods.description: Attempts to fetch data from a list of fallback API endpoints, trying sequentially until success or exhaustion.

methods.name: parsePosters
methods.description: Parses JSON response to extract a list of poster items with id, name, and poster URL.
